parameters.formTitle: Score a call that was not tracked
parameters.formDescription: For a call Fathom recorded but the tracker skipped, usually because it was never booked through the calendar and so has no title to match. Paste the recording ID or the Fathom share link from the Slack alert. Covers the last __WINDOW_DAYS__ days.

values.fieldLabel: Fathom recording ID or share link

values.placeholder: Leave blank if the call title already starts with their name

nodes.name: Ask Fathom - __CLOSER__
nodes.notes: Needs __CLOSER__'s own Fathom API key attached as an HTTP Header Auth credential (X-Api-Key). Continues on error on purpose: a key that is missing or expired must not take the form away from every other closer. If nothing is found, the Find the call node names how many recordings each account returned, so an empty account reads as an empty account rather than as a bad recording ID.

nodes.name: Send it to the tracker
nodes.notes: Posts to the tracker's own webhook rather than doing any scoring here, so a call rescued by hand goes through exactly the same dedupe, scoring and Notion write as one that arrived on its own.

parameters.completionMessage: The call is being scored now. It takes a couple of minutes to appear on the tracker. If anything goes wrong you will get the usual alert in the sales-tracker channel.
